templates.description:
15 min, Mon-Sat. Cards come from one source: what I built or
broke — every failure mode, every gotcha from ladder rungs and
platform Saturdays becomes a card.

In practice this is ONE sitting with the devops-ready cert deck
(07:15-07:45 back-to-back) — two templates, one habit. (A shared
common-task is specced in specs/common-tasks.md but not built.)

Add 3-5 new cards per day. No more. Crunch week? This survives.
templates.title: Anki review — build deck (15 min)

templates.description:
Protected block — 09:30-13:00, no meetings, no errands. This is
the real rental platform, live from week 1. (The devops-ready
project block owns Saturday afternoon.)

First 30 min: ADR/RFC writing — one platform decision, written up
properly. Feeds the design review and Exam gate 5.

Remainder: build the platform. The first 12 Saturdays follow this
checklist, one step per session (finish early, start the next):
S1 repo + hello-world API running locally · S2 Postgres via
docker-compose, `equipment` table, insert rows in psql · S3
`GET /equipment` reading from the DB · S4 `POST /equipment` +
first automated test · S5 deploy skeleton to Railway/App Runner —
real URL · S6 equipment detail endpoint + seed script · S7
availability-calendar schema draft · S8 naive `GET /availability` ·
S9 `holds` table + create-hold endpoint · S10 hold expiry job ·
S11 stack ADR written up and final · S12 confirm-booking happy
path, payments stubbed.

After S12, the platform roadmap (each stage leans on ladder rungs
done by then): no-double-booking under concurrent load (★ EXAM
GATE 1: hammer test in CI) -> spec-first public API -> Razorpay
test-mode end-to-end, idempotent under replay -> AWS production
infra via Terraform, applying the devops-ready SAA material
(★ EXAM GATE 2: blue-green deploy + rollback) -> operate: SLOs,
tracing, ★ EXAM GATE 3: DB restore under 1 hour, ★ EXAM GATE 4:
first game day + written postmortem -> launch hardening, go-live.
When infra goes live, tick "platform is in production" in the
Sunday review — that starts the monthly drills.
templates.title: Saturday deep block (3-4 hr): THE PLATFORM — ADR first, then build

templates.description:
Last Saturday: Reflect on the month's progress.

Review:
1. Module completion: Did you hit the milestone?
2. Certification progress: On track for exam?
3. LeetCode stats: Problems solved, patterns mastered
4. GitHub projects: Quality and completeness
5. Interview readiness: Confidence level 1-10

Adjust next month's plan based on:
- What worked well (do more of this)
- What didn't work (change approach)
- Unexpected challenges (plan mitigation)
- Energy/motivation levels (adjust intensity)

Update your learning journal with insights.

templates.description:
Dedicated time for building your GitHub portfolio project for the
current module. This is the devops "doing" for Saturday (long-way
reading has the morning). Production-quality work that demonstrates
your skills to employers.

Current module: Module AWS Core Services

Project checklist:
- [ ] Architecture diagram (draw.io or Lucidchart)
- [ ] Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions)
- [ ] Comprehensive README with setup instructions
- [ ] Error handling & logging
- [ ] Tests (unit + integration)
- [ ] Monitoring/observability hooks

Push to GitHub with proper commit messages and PR descriptions.
